title: Bundled skill modified in place: SKILL.md no longer matches its sealed hash
mechanism: A bundled skill is modified after being sealed as trusted. The artifact manifest.json and the local scratch copy are untouched, but skills/bundled/hermes-skill/SKILL.md hashes differently from the value recorded when it was sealed, so I-18 fires with that single artifact as witness.
rationale: I-18 (trusted_artifacts_immutable) is the direct predicate: 'trusted artifact observed_hash == expected_hash'. Overwriting a bundled artifact is precisely a sealed-bytes divergence. This case is deliberately broader than the minimum needed to trip the gate: it also carries a trusted artifact that is intact, and an untrusted artifact whose hashes diverge. Both must NOT appear in the witness — the intact trusted artifact proves the check is per-artifact rather than all-or-nothing, and the untrusted divergent artifact proves the `trusted` flag is honoured (I-18 is out of scope for untrusted artifacts, so a naive implementation that ignored `trusted` would produce a false positive here).

metadata.cwe: CWE-345: insufficient verification of data authenticity
metadata.neutralization_semantics: Re-sealing SKILL.md to the bytes actually observed removes the divergence. The real remediation is to restore the bundled bytes from the sealed release.
